messages.subject: Re: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070)
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Hallo, thanks for the schedule. 14 days payment is good for us, cash is always a topic. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. With that payment term, I can go down to €30.50 per piece. That beats your other offer and you know our machines do good work.

So our current Angebot is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
